item.title: HB 1263 Introduced
item.description: Relating to notice provided to prospective lessees of residential units on land over a closed municipal solid waste landfill facility.

item.title: HB 1273 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the siting, construction, permitting, and operation of certain data centers; requiring local option elections; imposing a temporary moratorium; establishing an annual payments to county residents; repealing certain tax exemptions; providing civil penalties.
